exposure: Late expression initiation (>6 hr from birth)
Nonexclusive use of own mother's milk
Previous neonatal intensive care unit experience
Inadequate expression frequency (≤6 times per a day)
outcome: Exclusivity of mother's breast milk use
cohort: 129 mothers of preterm infants in neonatal intensive care units
finding: High gestational age was associated with both late expression initiation and nonexclusive breast milk use.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was a significant predictor of late expression initiation.
